caption_link.limitation: The source provides matching numeric IDs only. It does not provide an original post URL, date, media link, or an explicit asset-to-caption key.

inspection.evidence_scope: Source-bound start, material-intermediate, and near-complete frames were extracted from the original local GIF and visually inspected; metadata came from that same source file.

motion_sampling.method: Three source-bound frame samples extracted from the original local GIF for review; no derivative was added to the corpus.
motion_sampling.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

visual_anatomy.title: The phrase “STRUCTURE” is placed in a prominent lavender tag inside an otherwise plain-language title.
visual_anatomy.layout: A conditional layout-selection board: one input (“framework has N parts”) branches to eight shape options with miniature diagrams.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Title → input tag → top row of compatible structures → lower row of further structures connected through the same branch spine.
visual_anatomy.typography: Large lightweight title, rough display accent, and compact explanatory labels directly above simple structural sketches.
visual_anatomy.colour: Alternating lavender, pink, aqua, and blue panels distinguish possible structures without becoming the main information code.
visual_anatomy.surface: White page, one continuous dark branching line, pale flat modules, thin rules, and minimal shadow.
visual_anatomy.modules: One variable input plus eight visual alternatives, each with a plain-language use condition and schematic.
visual_anatomy.density: High: multiple choices remain coherent because they answer one input question.

motion.observed_state_change: The sampled input moves from “2 parts” to “4+ parts”; its miniature diagrams add/expand their components before returning to the initial state as a loop.
motion.motion_job: Show how one change in input cardinality alters the candidate visual structures while preserving context.
motion.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Choose a visual structure by the actual relationship in a framework, not by decoration preference.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Expose the selection variable first, then show a finite set of shape options whose miniatures make the consequence visible.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only when the input variable is real and the choice rules reflect the underlying logic rather than a style preference.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the “eight layouts” taxonomy, example diagrams, lavender title tag, branching board, source wording, or motion loop.

claim_boundary.note: The visual is a framework reference. Its matching workbook caption remains an asserted numeric association, not source-proven post metadata.
